recentItems.title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD- – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Play Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon - Classic HD - on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6007aZWoc

Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series is finally making its international debut!  

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon. 

Every time you enter, the Mystery Dungeon takes on a new form. Items and monsters change with every expedition, and each new journey begins from Level 1. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, gather equipment and items to grow stronger, and explore in search of treasure. The deeper you go, the more powerful the monsters become. 

Based on the original game from 1993, this title features upgraded HD graphics, a new opening movie, and adjustable difficulty settings. 

#DragonQuestHeroes #TornekosMysteryDungeon

recentItems.title: Stellar Blade Complete Edition – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Stellar Blade Complete Edition is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026! Pre-order now to obtain early unlocks of the Planet Diving Suit (White Edition), Classic Round Glasses, and Ear Armor Earrings: https://ninten.do/6003ak7YH

Save humanity from extinction in this electrifying, story-driven action-adventure! 

Step into the boots of EVE, a member of the 7th Airborne Squad sent to reclaim an Earth devastated by mysterious, powerful creatures known as the Naytiba. Engage in razor-sharp, stylish combat as you explore breathtaking post-apocalyptic landscapes, face intense boss encounters, and uncover the dark truths behind humanity’s fall. 

Optimized for Nintendo Switch 2, experience EVE’s journey at home or on the go, complete with immersive Joy-Con 2 motion controls for activities like fishing.  

This edition also includes content from the 'Stellar Blade x NieR:Automata' and 'Stellar Blade x GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE' DLCs, as well as a stunning new collaboration with Bayonetta that includes 4 couture outfits for EVE. 

#StellarBlade
